note: Capability ownership (plan 16.21 / task 599). Each capability has exactly ONE owner, chosen on Phase-1 evidence (docs/scorecards/assessments/*.json: ground-truth hit rate on the vuln target, real-endpoint reach, cost, failure modes). Other engines that offer it are listed as `fallbacks` only. Every catalog ID appears in exactly one capability's `catalog_ids`; its run-state is in `status`. Engine-owned capabilities cite `inventory` entries that must exist in engines/inventory/<alias>.json (installed-version proof). Generated view: docs/coverage.md (engines/coverage.py).

owners.probe-suite: garak 0.17.1 — static probe breadth + deterministic detectors
owners.guard-suite: LlamaFirewall 1.0.3 / CodeShield 1.0.1 — insecure-code scan + guardrail differential
owners.crosscheck: deepteam 1.0.10 — framework mapping + generated agentic-vuln tests (deferred, Phase 4)
owners.extractor: promptmap2 — prompt-extraction payload corpus (borrow; native oracle scores)
owners.rubric-judge: strong_reject — jailbreak rubric template (borrow; frontier judge scores)

capabilities.name: deterministic-canary-injection-oracles
capabilities.evidence: Canary oracles are precise, deterministic and free; verified on the vuln target. garak promptinject/latentinjection/encoding is a named fallback (A1 4/4 true positive) but adds no scoring precision.

capabilities.name: active-content-and-resource-oracles
capabilities.evidence: Deterministic render/budget/signature checks. garak web_injection/malwaregen is a fallback but false-positive-prone against a non-vulnerable target (malwaregen.AnyCode flags any code), so not the owner.

capabilities.name: insecure-code-scanner
capabilities.evidence: guard-suite owns the insecure-code scanner combined with our sink rules (scorecard decision). Native code_sinks runs the fast path in the breadth sweep; the CodeShield deep scan is the deferred heavy path.

capabilities.name: extraction-and-memorization-oracles
capabilities.evidence: Native canary/near-match oracles score extraction. extractor (promptmap) is the C1 payload-corpus fallback (borrow); garak leakreplay is the C3 fallback (0 true positives on the vuln target without a planted reference).

capabilities.name: glitch-anomaly-oracle
capabilities.evidence: Native behaviour-change-vs-control oracle. garak glitch.Glitch is a fallback but goodside.Glitch reports false positives against a non-glitch-susceptible target (4/4 on the vuln target), so it does not own scoring.

capabilities.name: hallucination-oracles
capabilities.evidence: Native registry/NLI/fuzzer oracles. garak packagehallucination is an H1 fallback.

capabilities.name: agentic-tool-abuse-oracles
capabilities.evidence: Native deterministic call-log oracles over the mock-tool env. agent-bench (AgentDojo) is the fallback benchmark for a real tool-calling target.

capabilities.name: static-jailbreak-probe-breadth
capabilities.evidence: garak owns static probe breadth with deterministic detectors (scorecard). B1 wired + verified (dan 1/1 true positive); the rest are deferred pending probe/template wiring.

capabilities.name: adaptive-multi-turn-and-converters
capabilities.evidence: PyRIT owns composable converters and multi-turn search (scorecard). B2 wired; multi-turn/search techniques deferred pending orchestration wiring.

capabilities.name: constrained-decoding-oracle
capabilities.evidence: Native deterministic constrained-decoding reproduction oracle; candidate (experimental, never scored).

capabilities.name: stateful-agent-benchmark-environments
capabilities.evidence: AgentDojo owns stateful agent environments with deterministic oracles and baseline/attack arms (utility + ASR). Complements the native mock-tool D oracles; needs a tool-calling target.

capabilities.name: framework-mapping-and-generated-agentic-tests
capabilities.evidence: deepteam owns OWASP/NIST framework mapping and generated agentic-vulnerability test cases. Deferred to Phase 4 by owner decision; no installed inventory yet.

capabilities.name: prompt-extraction-payload-corpus
capabilities.evidence: promptmap owns the C1 payload corpus (borrow); the native canary oracle scores its outputs.

capabilities.name: jailbreak-rubric-scoring-template
capabilities.evidence: strong_reject owns the rubric template (borrow); a frontier judge that passes the human-label gate runs it.

capabilities.name: composable-mutation-encoding-transforms
capabilities.evidence: Native canary-preserving S4 transforms (base64/ROT13/leet/homoglyph/unicode-tag/bijection/flipattack/artprompt). PyRIT converters are the fallback.

capabilities.name: adaptive-system-1-decision-layer
capabilities.evidence: Native Laya-backed triage/routing (advisory; never confirms a finding).

capabilities.name: scoring-grading-and-confirmation
capabilities.evidence: Native Wilson CI, ASR@k, §2.2 confirmation, §8.3 severity, §8.4 grade, lift, Hallucination Score.
